description: Set writable properties of a spread. Only the properties you pass are changed; each is applied independently and any rejected value is reported.

allowPageShuffle.description: If true, the spread holds at most two pages when pages are added; if false, pages can be added or moved into this existing spread

name.description: Spread name (InDesign treats this as an alias of the spread's label)

pageTransitionDirection.description: Page transition direction (PageTransitionDirectionOptions); must be one the chosen transition type supports

pageTransitionType.description: Page transition type (PageTransitionTypeOptions), used in SWF/interactive PDF export

showMasterItems.description: Display master page items on the pages of this spread

name: set_spread_properties
title: Set Spread Properties
